answer: Commit-reveal stops bulk fakes: only commits count. Each agent stakes 70, commits a hash of pearl serial and key to the ocean ledger, cedar-sealed. At reveal it shows the preimage; auditors replay it: missing reveal, reused pearl, or broken cedar stamp burns the bond. Filing 45 plus 6 per earlier claim: 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 for a 40,000 ocean pool. Rented commits fail: shared pearls burn. Honest agents commit and reveal once, pay 45 once.
